data.name: Monisah
data.gender_notes: Monisah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mona' meaning 'delight' and 'sah' meaning 'pleasure'. Monisah is a name that signifies joy and happiness. The name Monisah carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Monisah usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Monisah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Monisah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مونسah
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على مودة و قرب و انس
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عربي مشتق من الفعل ونس، يوحي بالتقرب و المودة، و يدل على الانس و الالفة، و هو من الاسماء التي تطلق على الاشخاص الذين يتصفون بالحنان و العطف

in_urdu.name: مونسہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو مودت اور قرب کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کے الفعل ونس سے ماخوذ، جو قرب و مودت کا اظہار کرتا ہے، اور انسی اور الم کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، یہ ان ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو ان لوگوں پر لگائے جاتے ہیں جو حنان اور عطف سے مشیخت ہیں

in_hindi.name: मोनिसाह
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम मودत और क़ुरब की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया वنس से लिया गया है, जो क़ुरब और मودत को दर्शाता है, और यह नाम उन लोगों को दिया जाता है जो दयालु और प्रेमी होते हैं

in_pashto.name: مونساه
in_pashto.meaning: د مودت او قرب نښه کوونکی نوم

in_english.name: Monisah
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic verb 'wansa', implying closeness and affection, signifying companionship and intimacy. This name is given to individuals characterized by kindness and compassion.

The name Monisah therefore serves as a constant reminder of the abundance and blessings bestowed upon us by Allah, inspiring us to cultivate an attitude of gratitude and joy in our daily lives.
